facts.business: Jumbo Bag Limited manufactures and sells FIBC (Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers) / jumbo bags and trades in polymer raw materials.
key_risks: US tariff measures impacting export orders
West Asia geopolitical crisis affecting shipments
Legal and tax disputes with management assumptions on risk assessment
Dependence on imported raw materials (approx 50% of consumption)
facts.related_party_note: The company has not given any loans or advances in the nature of loans to promoters, directors, KMPs and their related parties either severally or jointly with any other person.
